notes.title: UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hello, it's been a few days since the game was released.
With this update, I have added "bonus(OMAKE)" content to the game.

This is "The Exit 8"-like content.
※The rules are simple: If there is the abnormality, return. And if there is no abnormality, go forward.

The difficulty level is easy, so feel free to play even if you find the main game difficult.
There are no saves and no achievement in the bonus mode, but I hope you enjoy it.

As for future plans, there are no plans for updates to add content.
However, the ending conditions for the main story may be difficult to understand, so I am considering creating a guide for the branching conditions in the community.

If you don't mind, I would be happy if you could tell me what you found interesting in the steam review.
